namespace EBI.EF
{
	public class BranchEF : DbContext
	{
		private string StrConn { get; set; }

		public virtual DbSet<tbl_Branch> tbl_Branch { get; set; }

		public BranchEF(string strCN)
		{
			StrConn = strCN;
		}

		protected override void OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
		{
			SqlServerDbContextOptionsExtensions.UseSqlServer(optionsBuilder, StrConn, (Action<SqlServerDbContextOptionsBuilder>)null);
		}

		protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
		{
		}
	}
	public class CashSales_PointConversionFormulaEF : DbContext

		}

		protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
		{
		}
	}

namespace EBI.EF.EFData
{
	public class tbl_Branch
	{
		[Key]
		[StringLength(40)]
		public string? BranchID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(100)]
		public string? BranchName { get; set; }

		[StringLength(256)]
		public string? Address1 { get; set; }

		[StringLength(256)]
		public string? Address2 { get; set; }

		[StringLength(256)]
		public string? Address3 { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string? Email { get; set; }

		[StringLength(256)]
		public string? Contact { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string? Phone { get; set; }

		[StringLength(20)]
		public string? GSTNo { get; set; }

		[StringLength(256)]
		public string? LogoPath { get; set; }

		[StringLength(20)]
		public string? BranchGroupID { get; set; }

		public bool? IsSuspended { get; set; }
	}
	public class tbl_CashSales_PointConversionFormula
	{
		[Key]
		[StringLength(15)]
		public string? PointID { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? ForEveryXDollar { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? EqualToXPoint { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? RMConversionRatio { get; set; }

		public bool? RoundDownToInteger { get; set; }

		[StringLength(500)]
		public string? MemberTypeID { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "smalldatetime")]
		public DateTime? FromDate { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "smalldatetime")]
		public DateTime? ToDate { get; set; }

		public int? ExpiryMonth { get; set; }

		public int? ExpiryOption { get; set; }

		[StringLength(4000)]
		public string? VisibleToBranchID { get; set; }

		public int? DaysCovered { get; set; }

		public bool? ExcludeTaxAmount { get; set; }
	}
	public class tbl_Messages
	{
		[Key]
		public long MessageID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(40)]
		public string? BranchID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string? SendFrom { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string? SendTo { get; set; }

		[StringLength(20)]
		public string? MessageType { get; set; }

		[StringLength(500)]
		public string? Message { get; set; }

		public DateTime? SubmissionDate { get; set; }

		[StringLength(200)]
		public string? DeliveryStatus { get; set; }

		public DateTime? DeliveryDate { get; set; }

		[StringLength(500)]
		public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string? CostCurrency { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? Cost { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string? CustomerCurrency { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? CustomerCharge { get; set; }

		[StringLength(5)]
		public string? CountryCode { get; set; }

		public DateTime? SeenDate { get; set; }

		public int? IsSuccessful { get; set; }

		public int? IsFailed { get; set; }

		public int? IsSeen { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "date")]
		public DateTime? FinancialDate { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string? MessageCategory { get; set; }
	}
	public class tbl_User
	{
		[Key]
		[StringLength(50)]
		public string UserID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(20)]
		public string? Password { get; set; }

		public bool? IsSuspended { get; set; }

		public bool? IsStatic { get; set; }

		public bool? IsDemo { get; set; }

		public bool? IsSuperAdmin { get; set; }

		public string? RefreshToken { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "datetime2")]
		public DateTime? RefreshTokenTimeSpan { get; set; }

		public bool? TwoFactorEnabled { get; set; }

		public DateTimeOffset? LockoutEnd { get; set; }

		public bool? LockoutEnabled { get; set; }

		public int? AccessFailedCount { get; set; }

		[StringLength(450)]
		public string? MFAToken { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string? NormalizedEmail { get; set; }

		public bool? MustSendActivationEmail { get; set; }

		public bool? EmailConfirmed { get; set; }
	}
	public class vw_Customer_Member
	{
		[Key]
		[StringLength(15)]
		public string MasterAccountID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(256)]
		public string AccountName { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string Phone { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string Email { get; set; }
	}
	public class vw_Inventory_getsimple
	{
		[Key]
		[StringLength(15)]
		public string MasterAccountID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(20)]
		public string DisplayCode { get; set; }

		[StringLength(256)]
		public string AccountName { get; set; }

		public int? AccountTypeID { get; set; }

		public int? InventoryTypeID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(15)]
		public string ItemGroupID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string ItemGroupName { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string SalesDescription { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? SalesPrice { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string Barcode { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string ProductCode { get; set; }

		[StringLength(300)]
		public string ImagePath { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "smalldatetime")]
		public DateTime? AvailableDateFrom { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "smalldatetime")]
		public DateTime? AvailableDateTo { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "time(0)")]
		public TimeSpan? AvailableTimeFrom { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "time(0)")]
		public TimeSpan? AvailableTimeTo { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? MaxDiscountLimit { get; set; }

		public bool? AllowFOCCreditOffset { get; set; }

		public bool? AllowVIPCreditOffset { get; set; }

		public bool? AllowPointRedemption { get; set; }

		[StringLength(100)]
		public string PointToRedeem { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? PVValue { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? QuantityFactor { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string SupplierProductCode { get; set; }

		[StringLength(3000)]
		public string CondimentGroupID { get; set; }

		public bool? IsOpenItem { get; set; }

		public bool? IsSerializedItem { get; set; }

		[StringLength(15)]
		public string UnitOfMeasureID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string UnitOfMeasureName { get; set; }

		[StringLength(15)]
		public string ItemTaxGroupID { get; set; }

		public bool? IsSold { get; set; }

		[StringLength(15)]
		public string PreferredVendorAccountID { get; set; }

		public int? ServiceMinutes { get; set; }

		[StringLength(2)]
		public string TriggeredMemberTypeID { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string TriggeredMemberTypeName { get; set; }

		public int? MemberExpiryDays { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? MemberMainAccountCredit { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? MemberFOCCreditEntitlement { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? MemberProductCredit { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? MemberServiceCredit { get; set; }

		[Column(TypeName = "money")]
		public decimal? MemberPoint { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string PrinterA { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string PrinterB { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string PrinterVoid2 { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string PrinterVoid1 { get; set; }

		[StringLength(10)]
		public string AccountStatus { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string BrandName { get; set; }

		[StringLength(50)]
		public string InventoryTypeName { get; set; }

		[StringLength(15)]
		public string TaxCodeID { get; set; }

		public bool? IsTaxInclusive { get; set; }
	}
}
